# The person who always tidies up

Compliance training ends at four, but Jo stays until five putting tools away. The rota does not count this hour because nobody assigned it. Rafi will close with her and record the tasks, not her speed. We should not distribute an invisible job by first praising someone for doing it without complaint. [[Volunteer handbook]] is starting to reveal a second shift behind every advertised shift.
